signature: SUBROUTINE DSTEV( JOBZ, N, D, E, Z, LDZ, WORK, INFO )

params.name: jobz
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
-   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

params.name: d
params.reference: On entry, the n diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.

params.name: e
params.reference: On entry, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A, stored in elements 1 to N-1 of E. On exit, the contents of E are destroyed.

params.name: Z
params.reference: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, Z contains the orthonormal eigenvectors of the matrix A, with the i-th column of Z holding the eigenvector associated with `D(i)`. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$, and if `JOBZ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the algorithm failed to converge; i off-diagonal elements of E did not converge to zero.
